title: Part 7
content_zh: The principle of speed: Let your rapidity be that of the wind, your compactness that of the forest. In raiding and plundering, be like fire. In immovability, be like a mountain.
content_en: The principle of speed: Let your rapidity be that of the wind, your compactness that of the forest. In raiding and plundering, be like fire. In immovability, be like a mountain.
